description: Discover Reticle tools on demand. Call with no arguments to list every tool (name + one-line summary); call with names:["reticle_network", …] to load full descriptions and parameters for specific tools. Then invoke them with reticle_run. This avoids paying for every tool definition on every turn. To make a verification REUSABLE (record once, replay free forever), the flow workflow lives here: reticle_record{action:"start"} → act → reticle_flow_save → reticle_verify{action:"flows"} (and reticle_verify { action: "heal" } on drift). Load those names when you want to save or re-run a flow.

action.description: "list": the catalogue, same as no arguments.

names.description: Tool names to load full params for. Omit to list all tools with summaries.

name: reticle_tools
